data.narrative:
The Bot Company is a Series B robotics and manufacturing firm founded by Kyle Vogt, Paril Jain, and Luke Holoubek, having raised approximately $550M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of four same-sector peers at Series B and adjacent Series C stages, supplemented by a broader universe of eight private robotics companies and one public comparator.

Peer-median analysis represents the primary applicable valuation method given data availability. The four direct comparables—Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B, Series C)—yield a median valuation of $1.6B and a range of $1.0B to $1.8B. This method reflects current market pricing for robotics firms at equivalent stages with similar sector exposure.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.4B (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $1.6B. This single-method result reflects limited alternative data points for cross-validation; DEX-comparable transaction multiples and revenue multiples were not available in the provided dataset. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set given rapid sector evolution, stage premium assumptions between Series B and Series C, and potential divergence in technology maturity or market traction across the comparables.
